ev.q: Among 203 candidemia cases in the Denver metropolitan area during May 2017–September 2018, 23 (11%) occurred in 22 patients
Ten (43%) of the 23 cases were considered community-onset infections
Seven (32%) of the 22 patients had disseminated candidiasis with end-organ dysfunctions
Nine (39%) cases were classified as hospital-onset infections

methods_quotes.q: Medical record reviews were performed to gather demographic and clinical information, including history of IDU, for all patients using a standardized case report form.
Cases were classified by patient epidemiologic exposures.
Hospital-onset infections were defined as blood cultures collected ≥3 days into the patient’s hospitalization.
